protocol.claim: Before starting a cluster, append {id, operator, branch, files, claimed_at} to 'claims' via a commit on YOUR branch AND a comment on your PR. The integrator copies accepted claims here.

protocol.wake: The integrator is woken by GitHub PR activity on subscribed PRs, and by a bounded recurring check-in. Neither is a guarantee of immediate response; usage limits apply.

It overrides product enhancements, individual construction generators, visual refinements, dashboard polish and non-critical Build 2 / Final Master work. Priority order: (1) critical safety/correctness defects affecting the workforce; (2) every missing autonomous connection and operational dependency; (3) end-to-end integration, certification and deployment; (4) sustained 24 h production acceptance and recovery verification; (5) remaining Build 2 / Final Master enhancements. Built code, merged PRs or isolated tests are not operational completion. Owner/physical/provider/account holds never stop unrelated eligible work. The authoritative inventory is P0_WIRING_50937469.md (department x criterion matrix) as extended by the integrator; no competing master plan.
consequences: no new construction generator or product template work by any worker until priorities 1-3 are clear (I-OPUS2-FREEZE-GENERATORS stands)
visual production is one required department, sequenced with the others
